p7_b0.ocr: The market share by region for PepsiCo in the Food & Beverage sector from 2019 to 2024 reveals significant trends. In the UK, the market share started at 32% in 2019 with units sold recorded at 1.2M and a growth rate of 5%. The following year, 2020, the market share increased to 34%, with units sold rising to 1.4M and a growth rate of 6%.

p7_b1.ocr: In 2021, the UK market share continued to grow to 36%, with units sold reaching 1.6M and a growth rate of 7%. By 2022, the market share further increased to 38%, with units sold at 1.8M and a growth rate of 8%. In 2023, the market share in the UK rose to 40%, with a total of 2.0M units sold and a growth rate of 9%.
